capabilities: Highlight more code block languages across Reading view, Source mode, and Live Preview
Support every bundled PrismJS language and CodeMirror parser language
Keep highlighted code blocks editable in Live Preview
Add custom regex-based languages as JSON files
Reuse Obsidian's native theme token classes for styling
extras: Manual install requires copying files into the plugin folder because the community installer only fetches main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css; custom language JSON files must be created manually.
intentEvidence: Extended Code Highlight adds broader, theme-compatible syntax highlighting for Obsidian code blocks
problem: Obsidian's built-in highlighting only covers some languages, so many fenced code blocks render unhighlighted or inconsistently across views.

relations.evidence: Every PrismJS language bundled from the PrismJS supported language list.
Uses CodeMirror parser highlighting where bundled parser support exists.

summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that adds more code block languages to Reading view, Source mode, and Live Preview using PrismJS, CodeMirror parsers, and custom regex rules.
